description: This file defines an enum called DBStatus used to represent different local change states for server synchronization in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It includes statuses like VOID, LOCAL_EDITED, and LOCAL_DELETED, each with an associated descriptive string.

classes.name: DBStatus
classes.description: An enum representing various local change statuses for server synchronization, such as VOID, LOCAL_EDITED, and LOCAL_DELETED.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the descriptive string associated with the DBStatus enum value.
